OPTIONAL: routes_admin.upload_chunk still appends chunks in arrival order without enforcing `index` sequencing — an out-of-order client could corrupt the CSV. (Carried over from iter 1.)

rca of the issue: Original bug: CMS CSV starts with the UTF-8 BOM sequence 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF, so the first header 'Prscrbr_NPI' was read as '\ufeffPrscrbr_NPI' and the COLUMN_MAP lookup missed it. With no 'npi' key in the mapping, every row hit the KeyError branch in _process_file and was skipped -> physicians collection was empty -> max_npi=0 -> estimated_share_pct=0 and warnings said 'Highest NPI is 0, file may be truncated'. Fix applied in /app/backend/routes_admin.py: (a) open both preview and streaming CSV with encoding='utf-8-sig' (auto-strips BOM), and (b) _norm() strips a stray \ufeff from any header just in case. Confirmed working: preview now returns detected_mapping={npi:0, last_name:1, first_name:2, city:3, state:4, specialty:5, tot_clms:10, tot_cost:13} and finalize returns unique_npis=45, total_rows=1000, min_npi=1003000126, max_npi=1003004201, estimated_share_pct=~0.1% > 0.
